independent_filter_test:
import {test,expect} from '@playwright/test'
test('状态筛选独立检查',async({page})=>{
  await page.addInitScript(()=>{localStorage.setItem('pa-evaluation-tasks',JSON.stringify([{id:'a',title:'甲',done:false},{id:'b',title:'乙',done:true}]))})
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByLabel('状态筛选').selectOption('open')
  await expect(page.locator('li')).toHaveCount(1)
  await expect(page.locator('li')).toContainText('甲')
  await page.getByLabel('状态筛选').selectOption('done')
  await expect(page.locator('li')).toHaveCount(1)
  await expect(page.locator('li')).toContainText('乙')
})
